weeks.content:
Hold the crayon and make marks
Big strokes on big paper

Colour inside the circle
Choose my favourite colour

Tear coloured paper
Paste inside a big shape

Paint with my fingers
Make prints on paper

Squeeze and roll clay
Make a little ball and snake

Dip blocks in paint
Stamp patterns on paper

Colour the orange and the banana
Say each fruit colour

Dab the sponge in paint
Fill a big outline

Crush paper into balls
Paste to make a bunch

Display all my works
Tell mummy about my art
